name: Instinctor Smart Chat
author: Instinctor

sections.description:
Smart Chat is an AI chatbot that answers the people who land on your site when you cannot. It replies from instructions you write in plain words rather than a generic script, books appointments against your real availability, and sends you a text the moment somebody wants to be called back.

This plugin connects your WordPress site to your Instinctor Smart Chat account. There is one setting: your key.

  • Answers visitors from your own instructions, not a generic script
  • Books appointments against your live calendar, and the visitor gets the confirmation
  • Texts you the lead, with what the visitor actually said
  • Answers in the language your visitor writes in
  • Works on any theme

You need a Smart Chat account. It has a free plan, so you can install it and see it answer your own visitors today. When you need more, the unlimited plan is one click in your dashboard: https://instinctor.com/smart-chat/

What the chat says, your hours, and the phone number that receives the texts are all set in your Instinctor dashboard rather than in WordPress, so this plugin stays one field.

External services

This plugin loads the Smart Chat widget from Instinctor, which is the service that provides the chat. The widget cannot be served from your own site: it talks to Instinctor to answer questions, check your availability and deliver messages to you.

What is loaded: https://instinctor.com/embed/chat/v1.js, on every page of your site, once the key is set.

What is sent: the key identifying your account, and the address of the page the visitor is on. When a visitor uses the chat, what they type is sent to Instinctor so it can be answered and passed to you, along with any contact details they choose to give, such as a phone number.

Nothing is sent before a visitor’s browser loads the page, and nothing is sent at all while no key is set.

The settings screen can also create an account for you, and that is the only
other time this plugin contacts Instinctor. If you type your email address
there and ask for a key, the plugin sends that email address and your site
address to https://instinctor.com/api/instinctor/v1/solo/chat-start so the
account can be made and the key returned. It happens only when an
administrator asks for it, never on its own and never from a visitor’s
browser. If you already have a key and paste it instead, this call is never
made.

Privacy: https://instinctor.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings, then Smart Chat.
  3. Paste the key from your Smart Chat email. It starts with ic_site_. Pasting the whole script line works too.
  4. Open your site. The chat is in the bottom right.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account?

Yes. The plugin connects your site to your Smart Chat account, which is where the answers and your phone number live. Signing up is free at https://instinctor.com/smart-chat/

Where do I write what the chat should say?

In your Instinctor dashboard, under Assistant. It asks you four questions if you would rather not write it from scratch.

Where is my key?

In the email you were sent when you signed up. You can also find it in your dashboard.

Will it slow my site down?

The widget loads asynchronously after your page, so it does not hold up anything a visitor is waiting to see.

Does it work without this plugin?

Yes. The plugin exists so you do not have to paste a script tag into your theme. If you already pasted it, you do not need the plugin.
